entities.name: Paging procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to page UEs by transmitting Paging messages at their paging occasions.

entities.name: Paging message
entities.description: Message transmitted by the network at UE's paging occasion to initiate paging procedure.

entities.name: PagingRecord
entities.description: Information element included in Paging message to address individual UEs.

entities.name: Paging occasion
entities.description: Specific time occasion when network transmits paging messages as specified in TS 38.304.

relations.description: Paging procedure is initiated by transmitting Paging message
Paging message may contain multiple PagingRecord IEs to address multiple UEs
Paging message is transmitted at UE's paging occasion
